{{Quote|&hellip;Beware the shadows of Esne, goddess of envy and twin of Aivela. Forever eclipsed by her sister's incandescence, she will use her venomous tongue to test the faithful and cull the weak&hellip;|"The Admonition of Esne," part of a Zakuulan devotional text|<ref name="Text" />}}
'''Esne''' was the goddess of envy among the [[Six Gods|Old Gods]], the [[Deity/Legends|deities]] worshiped by the people of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Zakuul]] prior to [[Tenebrae|Valkorion's]] ascension to Immortal [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]]. One of the four children of [[Izax]] and [[Scyva]], Esne was the twin sister of [[Aivela]], the goddess of passion, and Esne's greed and hatred of her sister led her to test the faithful and weed out the weak from among them by inciting jealous and envy. The phrase "Eyes of Esne" was a common metaphor for jealousy among the people of Zakuul.<ref name="Text" />

Esne originated as an experimental [[Iokath]] titanic wardroid superweapon, built by an ancient, but highly advanced [[Unidentified Iokath species|people]]. She, along with her five brothers and sisters, were tested on several unsuspecting worlds, leading to over ten trillion casualties, one of the worlds being Zakuul, which is why Esne was worshiped there.<ref name="SWTOR">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=codex|The Six Gods}}</ref>
